Giant Eagle supermarkets and pharmacies (operating primarily in the US Midwest and Mid-Atlantic) stock traditional diabetes supplies like blood glucose meters, test strips, and nutritional shakes
, but
they do not typically carry consumer smartwatches, wearable ECGs, or non-pharmacy continuous glucose monitors (CGMs) on retail shelves
. Prescription CGMs (such as Abbott FreeStyle Libre
or Dexcom) can sometimes be filled through
Giant Eagle Pharmacy
with a doctor's prescription.
